english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a difficulty that needs to be solved or dealt with.
This is the all-purpose noun for a matter that is an issue, concern, or problem.
This is the all-purpose choice for a problem, technical difficulty, or vague personal concern.
Use this for a concern as a possible problem or issue, especially in phrases like questions or concerns.
This is the all-purpose noun for a concrete problem, including a health or mechanical problem.
Use 問題 when the object is an issue or problem attracting attention or concern.
Use this when the difficulty is viewed as a problem that needs solving, especially in everyday speech.
Use this when the complaint means an underlying problem, difficulty, or concern rather than the act of complaining.

english.note: Use 問題 as the all-purpose word for an ordinary question, a topic or issue, or a matter whose validity is at issue.
This is the all-purpose choice for a question or inquiry.
Use this as the all-purpose word for a question that someone puts forward.
